notes.title: Check out our friend's first indie game - Starseed
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there[/h3]


A company we are closely allied with, are working on their first game. Please take some time to check it out and maybe wishlist it if you like it.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263170/Starseed/

[h3]This is Starseed[/h3]


Starseed is a crafting, farm sim based on finding out if a newly discovered planet can be made habitable. 

"A farm sim with dark undertones and an isolated atmosphere"

The world is in chaos! Humans have ruthlessly sucked the life out of Earth. We face horrible consequences. Trained for space travel for a daunting mission of finding out if a newly discovered planet can be made habitable. 



Features:

Start by naming the new planet - you are the first inhabitant after all.

[list]
[*]    Exploration
[*]     Researching
[*]     Crafting
[*]     Side Missions
[*]     Procedural Generation  
[/list]

         And many more


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12158146/c8ee04e6c915c85634b3a1f2bc5424fc35efa3ac.png[/img]



Thanks for your time. Check it out and wishlist if you are interested


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1263170/Starseed/
